name: Arathi Highlands
_terrain: stock = place spawns on stock 3.3.5 ground (no client terrain patch yet). turtle = keep Turtle heights (after the client terrain patch + map re-extraction).
notes: Thunder Ale boat party, Prince Herman II, training dummy and Moonkin Hatchling are Turtle systems/events, left out.
Kaja's Ammunition Crate / Mysterious Shipment belong to quest lines of other zones.
_hold_until_terrain_patch: Subzones Turtle rebuilt from scratch (Wildtusk Village, Ruins of Zul'Rasaz). On stock 3.3.5 terrain they are cliffs, so their NPCs, objects and quests are held back while terrain=stock.
_terrain_tiles: Turtle ADT tiles (Azeroth_X_Y) shipped in the client patch and converted to server .map files.
_area_bits: Exploration bits for Turtle's new subzones. Never change one once players have explored it; new areas get the next free bit.
